facts.statement: A player's hand consists of the cards that player holds.
facts.sourceSentence: Hand: The cards each player holds.

facts.statement: Each player begins the game holding 3 cards.
facts.sourceSentence: Each starts with 3 and ends the game with 10.

facts.statement: Each player finishes the game holding 10 cards.

facts.statement: A Set is a group of two or more cards whose numbers match.
Three 5s is given as an example of a Set.
A Run is a group of three or more cards in consecutive numeric order.
The cards 5, 6, 7 are given as an example of a Run.
Card numbers span the range 1 through 7.
facts.sourceSentence: There are numbers ranging from 1-7 in 4 colors, with 4 copies of each card.
